about: Gates that must exist for each phase (exit 21 when one is missing). The protected-resource gate (lane L3) is required for change sets: if its file were ever missing, every run would stop with exit 21 after the change sets are previewed and before any is executed, adoption runs included. A lane that adds a gate adds its name here, one line, and says so in its DONE file. Other gates found in ops/pipeline/gates also run; a failing one stops the step.
